hints.title: Two Choices per Question
hints.text: For each question, you can either solve it and skip the next brainpower questions, or skip it and proceed to the next question.

hints.title: Process Right to Left
hints.text: Define dp[i] as the maximum points attainable starting from question index i to the end.

hints.title: DP Recurrence
hints.text: dp[i] equals the maximum of skipping (dp[i + 1]) and solving (points[i] + dp[min(n, i + brainpower[i] + 1)]).

hints.title: Complete Python Solution
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def mostPoints(self, questions: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(questions)
        dp = [0] * (n + 1)
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            pts, bp = questions[i]
            next_idx = min(n, i + bp + 1)
            dp[i] = max(dp[i + 1], pts + dp[next_idx])
        return dp[0]
```

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branching without memoization has O(2^N) exponential complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Backward linear DP computes optimal points in O(N) time with O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: State recurrence clearly and handle index out of bound jump clamping.
